# CP-3 Functional Description: Review and Revised Narrative

The integrator's text has four design faults. The first three are the most serious.
- The E-stop is a PLC function.
- Guard doors restart the machine automatically.
- The PackML Held and Suspended states are swapped.
- Most of the behavior a FAT needs is missing.

The revised narrative follows the findings. It uses the PackML state model (ISA-TR88.00.02), not ISA-106. ISA-106 covers continuous process and does not fit a discrete packaging machine.

## 1. Review findings

| ID | Location | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | E-stop | The PLC input I:3/0 stops the motors. A standard PLC input cannot be the E-stop function. The text gives no stop category and no reset. | Make the E-stop a hardwired or safety-rated circuit that removes drive power. Use I:3/0 as a status input only. Specify the safety function in the SRS. FR-CP3-017 defines the PLC response. |
| F-02 | E-stop | The text gives no latch, reset method, or restart rule. | Latch the Aborted state. Require E-stop release, safety reset, Clear, Reset, then Start (FR-CP3-017). |
| F-03 | Guard doors | The machine resumes automatically when the doors close. This is an unexpected-restart hazard. | Remove auto-resume. Go to Stopped and require Reset and Start (FR-CP3-016). |
| F-04 | Guard doors | "Pauses" is not a state. The text does not say what happens in Held, Suspended, or Idle. It gives no per-door indication and no safety reference. | Use Stopping then Stopped from any moving state. Inhibit start while any door is open. Reference the SRS for the safety function. |
| F-05 | States | Downstream full is mapped to Held. Operator Stop is mapped to Suspended. Both are wrong. | Downstream full goes to Suspended. Operator Stop goes to Stopping then Stopped (FR-CP3-013, FR-CP3-012). |
| F-06 | Downstream full | The text gives no sensor tag, no debounce, and no restart rule. | Name the sensor (open item OI-01). Add on-delay and off-delay setpoints. Resume automatically. |
| F-07 | Starvation | "Stops" has no state. The 5 s value is in prose. The text gives no restart rule, no running qualifier, and no bad-PV handling. | Go to Suspended. Move the value to SP-CP3-002. Add the restart rule and PE-310 fault handling. |
| F-08 | Jam | The text gives no time qualifier. Product also blocks PE-320 in normal flow. It gives no action, reset, or PE-320 location. | Use a blocked-time delay. Go to Held, latched, with a manual reset (FR-CP3-015). Confirm the PE-320 location (OI-04). |
| F-09 | Speed | The 30 is in prose. The text gives no tolerance and no adjustability. | Use SP-CP3-001 and SP-CP3-013. Change after FAT only through MOC. |
| F-10 | Sequences | The text has no Start, Stop, Reset, or Clear sequence. Nothing has a timeout or failure response. | Added in Section 5. |
| F-11 | Abnormal handling | The text does not cover bad PV, comms loss, power loss, restart, or fail positions. | Added in Section 8. |
| F-12 | Document | The text has no requirement IDs, no test methods, no alarm list, and no operator interface. Motors, conveyors, and the stack light have no tags. | IDs and FAT tests added. Alarms are in Section 7. The interface is in Section 9. Missing tags are in OI-01. |

## 2. Revised narrative: Case Packer CP-3

### 2.1 Purpose and boundaries

CP-3 packs bottles into cases. The infeed conveyor supplies bottles. The outfeed conveyor removes cases.

| ID | Requirement | FAT test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CP3-001 | CP-3 must pack at the rated speed in SP-CP3-001, within the tolerance in SP-CP3-013. | Run 10 min in Execute. Count cases. |

### 2.2 Equipment and tags

No instrument index was given. These are the tags this module uses.

| Tag | Function |
|---|---|
| I:3/0 | E-stop status input (not the safety function) |
| GS-1 to GS-6 | Guard door switches |
| PE-310 | Infeed bottle detection |
| PE-320 | Jam detection (location to confirm, OI-04) |
| TBD (OI-01) | Downstream-full sensor, infeed and outfeed conveyor motors, packer drives, stack light, start horn |

### 2.3 States and transitions

Completing and Complete are not used (OI-09).

| State | Entry permissive | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|
| Stopped | From Stopping or Clearing | Resetting (operator Reset) |
| Resetting | E-stop released, GS-1 to GS-6 closed, no latched fault | Idle (auto), Stopped (failure) |
| Idle | Reset complete | Starting (operator Start), Stopping |
| Starting | Start command, start permissives true (FR-CP3-010) | Execute (auto), Stopping |
| Execute | Starting, Unsuspending, or Unholding done | Suspending, Holding, Stopping, Aborting |
| Suspending, Suspended | Downstream full or infeed starved | Unsuspending (auto), Stopping, Aborting |
| Unsuspending | Suspend cause cleared | Execute (auto), Suspending, Stopping |
| Holding, Held | Jam, photoeye fault, or operator Hold | Unholding (operator), Stopping, Aborting |
| Unholding | Cause cleared, alarm reset, operator Unhold | Execute (auto), Stopping |
| Stopping | Stop command, guard open, or sequence failure | Stopped (auto), Aborting |
| Aborting, Aborted | E-stop, comms loss, or Stopping failure | Clearing (operator Clear) |
| Clearing | E-stop released, safety reset done | Stopped (auto) |

| ID | Trigger | Transition | Initiator / level | FAT test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CP3-010 | Start permissives: Idle, GS-1 to GS-6 closed, E-stop released, PE-320 clear, no latched fault | Idle to Starting | Operator-prompted | Open each GS. Confirm that Start is refused. |
| FR-CP3-011 | Operator Start | Starting to Execute | Operator, then automatic | Push Start. Confirm the Section 5 sequence. |
| FR-CP3-012 | Operator Stop in any state except Aborting or Aborted | To Stopping, then Stopped | Operator | Push Stop in each state. |
| FR-CP3-013 | Downstream-full sensor on for SP-CP3-004 | Execute to Suspending, then Suspended. Off for SP-CP3-005 gives Unsuspending, then Execute. | Automatic | Block the sensor. Release it. Time both delays. |
| FR-CP3-014 | No bottles at PE-310 for SP-CP3-002 while the infeed conveyor runs | Execute to Suspending, then Suspended. Bottles present for SP-CP3-006 gives Unsuspending, then Execute. | Automatic | Remove bottles. Time the delay. Restore bottles. |
| FR-CP3-015 | PE-320 blocked for SP-CP3-003 | Execute to Holding, then Held. Latched. Resume needs a cleared PE-320, Alarm Reset, and operator Unhold. | Automatic, then operator | Hold a bottle at PE-320. Confirm the latch and reset. |
| FR-CP3-016 | Any of GS-1 to GS-6 opens | To Stopping, then Stopped. No auto-resume. After the doors close: Reset, then Start. | Automatic, then operator | Open each GS in Execute, Held, and Suspended. Close it. Confirm no motion. |
| FR-CP3-017 | Any E-stop pressed (safety circuit status) | To Aborting, then Aborted. Latched. Recovery: release E-stop, safety reset, Clear, Reset, Start. | Automatic, then operator | Press each E-stop. Confirm the latch and the recovery path. |

The safety circuit removes drive power for E-stop and guard stops. Stop category and performance level are in the SRS (OI-02). The PLC does not perform these safety functions.

### 2.4 Regulatory control

The integrator described no control loops. Conveyor speed coupling to case rate is open (OI-05).

### 2.5 Sequences

Starting, Unsuspending, and Unholding use the same steps. Motor tags are TBD (OI-01).

**Starting / Unsuspending / Unholding**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check start permissives. | All true | SP-CP3-008 | Stopping. Alarm AL-CP3-08. |
| 2 | Sound the start horn. | Horn time SP-CP3-007 done | SP-CP3-008 | Stopping. |
| 3 | Start the outfeed conveyor. | Running feedback | SP-CP3-008 | Stopping. Alarm AL-CP3-08. |
| 4 | Start the packer mechanism. | Running feedback | SP-CP3-008 | Stopping. Alarm AL-CP3-08. |
| 5 | Start the infeed conveyor. | Running feedback | SP-CP3-008 | Stopping. Alarm AL-CP3-08. |

**Stopping**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stop the infeed conveyor. | Zero speed | SP-CP3-009 | Aborting |
| 2 | Stop the packer mechanism. | Zero speed | SP-CP3-009 | Aborting |
| 3 | Stop the outfeed conveyor. | Zero speed | SP-CP3-009 | Aborting |

**Suspending / Holding**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stop the infeed conveyor. | Zero speed | SP-CP3-009 | Stopping |
| 2 | Let the packer finish the case in progress. | Packer cycle done | SP-CP3-009 | Stopping |
| 3 | Stop the packer. Keep the outfeed conveyor on. | Packer at zero speed | SP-CP3-009 | Stopping |

**Aborting, Clearing, Resetting**

| State | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aborting | Remove all run commands. Turn on the red light. | All feedback stopped | SP-CP3-010 | Stay in Aborting. Alarm AL-CP3-10. |
| Clearing | Check E-stop released and safety reset done. | Both true | SP-CP3-011 | Stay in Aborted. |
| Resetting | Reset faults. Check devices ready and PE-320 clear. | All true | SP-CP3-011 | Stopped. Alarm AL-CP3-11. |

### 2.6 Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was given.

| Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Any E-stop pressed | Aborting (FR-CP3-017) | Latched | E-stop release, safety reset, Clear, Reset |
| Any of GS-1 to GS-6 open | Stopping. Start inhibited. | Latched until Reset | Close all doors. Push Reset. |
| Downstream full | Suspending | Auto-reset | Sensor off for SP-CP3-005 |
| PE-310 starved | Suspending | Auto-reset | Bottles present for SP-CP3-006 |
| PE-320 jam | Holding | Latched | Clear jam. Alarm Reset. Unhold. |
| Photoeye fault (PE-310 or PE-320) | Holding | Latched | Repair. Alarm Reset. Unhold. |
| Comms loss for SP-CP3-012 | Aborting | Latched | Restore comms. Clear. Reset. |

### 2.7 Alarms

No alarm database was given. Priorities are provisional (OI-07).

| ID | Trigger | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| AL-CP3-01 | E-stop pressed | High | Find the cause. Release the E-stop. Reset. |
| AL-CP3-02 | Guard door open (door ID shown) | Medium | Close the door. Push Reset. |
| AL-CP3-03 | Jam at PE-320 | Medium | Clear the jam. Reset the alarm. Push Unhold. |
| AL-CP3-04 | Infeed starved | Low | Check bottle supply. |
| AL-CP3-05 | Downstream full | Low | Check the downstream line. |
| AL-CP3-06 | PE-310 fault | Medium | Repair PE-310. |
| AL-CP3-07 | PE-320 fault | Medium | Repair PE-320. |
| AL-CP3-08 | Start step failed or timed out | Medium | Read the step shown. Fix the cause. |
| AL-CP3-09 | Comms loss | High | Check the network. |
| AL-CP3-10 | Aborting timeout | High | Call maintenance. |
| AL-CP3-11 | Reset failed | Medium | Check the faults shown. |

### 2.8 Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Response | FAT test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CP3-020 | PE-310 or PE-320 signal fault | Holding. Do not treat the fault as starved or clear. | Disconnect each sensor. |
| FR-CP3-021 | Downstream-full sensor fault | Treat as full. Suspending. Alarm. | Disconnect the sensor. |
| FR-CP3-022 | Comms loss to a drive or I/O rack for SP-CP3-012 | Aborting. The drives stop on comms loss. | Pull the network cable. |
| FR-CP3-023 | HMI comms loss | The machine keeps its state. Alarm. | Pull the HMI cable. |
| FR-CP3-024 | Power loss and restart | All motors stop. On restore, the PLC starts in Aborted. No auto-restart. | Cycle the power in Execute. |
| FR-CP3-025 | Fail positions | All motors fail de-energized. Actuator and brake fail positions are open (OI-06). | Remove power. Check each output. |

### 2.9 Operator interface

| ID | Requirement | FAT test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CP3-030 | The screen must show the state, active alarms, case count, and actual rate against SP-CP3-001. | Inspect the screen. |
| FR-CP3-031 | The screen must show the status of GS-1 to GS-6 and the E-stop. | Open each GS. Check the screen. |
| FR-CP3-032 | The screen must offer Start, Stop, Reset, Clear, Hold, Unhold, and Alarm Reset. | Push each command. |
| FR-CP3-033 | The screen must show these prompts. | Cause each condition. |

Prompts (operations must approve them):
- "Close guard door GS-x. Push Reset."
- "Clear the jam at PE-320. Push Unhold."
- "Release the E-stop. Push Clear."

Stack light convention (provisional, OI-07):
- Red, steady: Aborting or Aborted.
- Amber, flashing: Held.
- Amber, steady: Suspended.
- Green: Execute.

Operators cannot change setpoints. After construction starts, changes go through MOC only.

### 2.10 Setpoint list

| ID | Description | Value | Units | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SP-CP3-001 | Rated speed | 30 | cases/min | From integrator. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-002 | Infeed starvation delay (PE-310) | 5 | s | From integrator. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-003 | Jam delay (PE-320 blocked) | 3 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-004 | Downstream-full on-delay | 5 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-005 | Downstream-full off-delay | 3 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-006 | Starvation clear delay | 3 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-007 | Start horn time | 5 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-008 | Step timeout: Starting, Unsuspending, Unholding | 30 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-009 | Step timeout: Stopping, Suspending, Holding | 30 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-010 | Step timeout: Aborting | 10 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-011 | Step timeout: Clearing, Resetting | 30 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-012 | Comms-loss timeout | 2 | s | Provisional. Confirm. |
| SP-CP3-013 | Speed tolerance | 2 | % | Provisional. Confirm. |

### 2.11 Open items

| ID | Item | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| OI-01 | Tag numbers for conveyors, motors, packer drives, downstream-full sensor, stack light, horn | Integrator | 2026-11-01 |
| OI-02 | SRS for E-stop and guard interlocks: stop category, performance level, safety reset | Safety engineer | 2026-11-08 |
| OI-03 | Confirm all provisional setpoints | Process engineer | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-04 | PE-320 location and jam logic | Integrator | 2026-11-08 |
| OI-05 | Conveyor speed relation to case rate; bottles per case | Process engineer | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-06 | Actuator and brake fail positions | Integrator (mechanical) | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-07 | Alarm priorities and stack light colors per plant philosophy | Controls lead | 2026-11-08 |
| OI-08 | Operations sign-off on states and prompts | Operations manager | 2026-11-22 |
| OI-09 | Confirm Completing and Complete are unused; define operating modes (Auto, Manual, Maintenance) | Operations manager | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-10 | Network topology, to confirm the comms-loss response | Integrator | 2026-11-08 |
